title: A Wardrobe for the Glasshouse
author: Juniper Nystrom
blurb: Lena Dravenmoor, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
